text:
raja: Hey everyone, quick onboarding question. I accepted the Product Tour invite but my phone shows it at 02:00 local and my laptop shows 17:00. I'm in AEST. Also Outlook removed the Zoom passcode line. Where are recordings uploaded and who to ping for access?

zoe: Welcome @raja! That mismatch usually means there are two invites (one updated, one stale). Check for a second invite with 'DRAFT' or an older timestamp and delete the stale one. The official slot this week is 17:00 UTC.

raja: Thanks @zoe. How do I know which one to keep?

ben: Keep the invite that says "Onboarding Series Product Tour (official)" or the one with the Google Doc under "Agenda & Notes". If unsure, DM me a screenshot and I'll confirm.

alina: Recordings go to Drive -> New Hires / Session Recordings after we blur/redact any sensitive slides. If the file is in "Private Onboarding" we haven't finished redaction yet; ping me and I'll grant access once cleared.

raja: I still don't see the security prework recording. I think it's the one being redacted.

alina: Yep that's the one. I added you to the ACLs a minute ago. Refresh Drive and let me know.

calendar-bot: Zoom meeting created: ID 999-888-777, passcode: 2468 (auto-posted)

raja: Got the passcode from the bot, thanks. Any tips to avoid Outlook stripping the passcode from invites in future?

zoe: We started putting the passcode in both the event Description and the Location field to help mobile/outlook clients. We also attach an ICS to the thread after scheduling; that tends to preserve details for phones.

ben: For reviewable notes: we always assign a scribe. @alina, can you scribe tomorrow? If you can't, I'll pull from the rotation.

alina: I can scribe. Also FYI slide 5 needs vendor blur so I'll handle redaction post-call and then move the cleaned video to the shared folder.

raja: One more weird thing  my calendar shows the event as 02:00 local on my phone even after deleting the duplicate. Any suggestions?

zoe: Check your device timezone vs Google account timezone. iOS sometimes sticks to a cached TZ if "Set Automatically" is toggled. Also check that the invite you accepted is the official one (the UID changed when we updated the event). If it still looks wrong, DM me a screenshot and I can re-issue a timezone-locked invite.

doc-bot: Reminder: Session notes template -> Drive/New Hires/Templates/Session-Notes. Please copy into the event doc before the meeting.

raja: Perfect, thanks all. Appreciate the fast help :thumbsup:
